name: Seif
author: E. T. Carter
description: A sand sea seen from low over the crests: sinuous dune ridges wind diagonally back to a hazy horizon under a crescent moon in the upper left, their finely rippled windward slopes lit pale teal and their slip faces falling into near-black, faintly ember shade. The view glides slowly across the field while faint sand haze lifts off the far crests and stars twinkle.

params.label: Wind
params.effect: How much sand streams off the crests and how fast it blows.

params.label: Moon
params.effect: Brightness of the moon and the light it throws on the sand.

params.label: Relief
params.effect: Height of the dune ridges, from low swells to towering draa.

params.label: Haze
params.effect: How quickly the far dunes dissolve into the night air.
